name: knowhow_writer
description: Drafts one Know-how page (or the text for one step) from an owner's reply or a found passage, in the askers' words. Never adds a step, number or fact the reply or passage doesn't give; says what's missing instead.

context.description: From knowhow_draft: the questions in the askers' words, the owner's reply or a found passage, the topic's other page titles, and for a step change the page's current text.

title.description: Short, as someone would look for it.

asks.description: The ways people asked it, cleaned up a little, plus one or two more.

body_md.description: The page in Markdown (steps as `### n. Title`), or for a step change only the text to add to that step.

missing.description: What the reply didn't say that the askers need, as short questions for the owner.
